description: Data Isolation Gatekeeper rule set: whitelist functions / allowed tables / least-privilege / session tokens / audit bridge (computable, single source of truth)
min_access_rule: SELECT-only on allowed tables; any write operation is denied by default (requires an explicit human override)

token_validation.note: caller name + session token dual-identification; the token plaintext is returned only once at issue time, the session store keeps only its hash; expired tokens are rejected

overrides.note: write/over-table grants require an explicit human decision (human_decision=override + reason), optional TTL, fully auditable

audit_bridge.note: gatekeeper events are dual-written (local + any 16-column audit sink); set pkg_dir or env AUDIT_PKG_DIR to your audit package; degrades gracefully when unreachable

event_contract.redaction: sensitive values never logged; only field names and existence; token/param/secret values are never persisted
